page.layout: One main text column on the left, with a narrow column of marginal notes on the right. Running head at the top left, page number at the top right. Gathering signature and catchword at the foot.

main_text.p: gnita fere mansit ad tempora Ale-xandri M. cujus ætate XII. IndorumDistri-butum in XII. regna. regna numerabantur ex quibus præ-cipua fuerunt Taxiles & Pori.
main_text.head: IMPERIA AFRICANA
ÆGYPTI.
Canon.
main_text.p: Ægyptii Asiâ[?] potiti regnum Sinense condiderunt.(i.) Æ-gyptia-cum.
main_text.head: Explicatio i.
main_text.p: Celeberrimum in antiqua hi-storia regnum Ægyptiorum fuit; Sed catalogus Regum, qui vulgò extat, admodum corruptus & inexplicabilis est.Catalo-gus Regum corru-ptus,
main_text.head: Explicatio ii[?]
main_text.p: Imperium Ægyptiorum, quod in universam penè Asiam obtinuerunt,Asiam obtinue-runt, apud Historicos parùm celebratur:

page.notes: Right margin notes placed beside the lines where they stand; the heading "II. Afri-cana & quidem" in the margin is a marginal reference, rendered within the notes above and at the Afri-cana heading. Page number "ij" read as a two-letter form and marked uncertain. The Greek-like glyph in "Explicatio ii" and the accent on "Asiâ" are doubtful. Printed "Sinenfe" read with long s as "Sinense". Margin note "II. Afri-cana & quidem" and "Distri-butum in XII. regna." were both present on the right and are recorded there.
